docs._: Copy this file to start a new map. Every key below is explained here, and this block is ignored by the loader.
docs.name: Shown on the loading card and in logs.
docs.tileSize: World size of one tile. Every shipped map uses 0.5.
docs.backgroundTexture: Optional. One image stretched over the whole map, behind the tile layers. Draw it at 16 pixels per tile. Omit the key if the map has no composed art.
docs.legend: Tile symbols. type is FLOOR, WALL, PLATFORM, HAZARD, LADDER or DECORATIVE. Any other key, such as damage or hidden, is carried as a tile property and read back by the feature that wants it.
docs.entityLegend: Entity symbols, a SEPARATE namespace from legend, so the same letter can mean different things in the two. type is PLAYER, ENEMY, LOOT or MARKER.
docs.marker: A MARKER needs a kind, which groups it, and may have an id and any other keys. Read them back with getSpawns().getMarkers(kind). Use this to place anything the map system does not know about.
docs.enemyType: Must match a name registered with EntitySpawnRegistry. An unregistered name is logged and skipped, so you may place an entity before its code exists.
docs.layers: Drawn back to front in this order. background and foreground are art only; terrain also drives collision; entities is spawn data, not tiles.
docs.rows: Rows read top to bottom, but the loader flips them, so y = 0 is the BOTTOM row. A space is an empty cell.
docs.transitions: Doorways. x and y are on THIS map; destinationSpawn is a tile on the destination map.
